headline: WSN @ ARI matchup research
quickWriteup: The current model score is WSN 4.66 at ARI 3.73, with a projected total of 8.39. Movement read: The side movement strengthened toward WSN: WSN moved +1.00 runs while ARI moved -0.49, changing the projected margin by +1.49 runs. The projected total climbed +0.51, which points to more offensive expectation than the earliest saved read. NRFI probability rose +24.7%, so the first-inning read became more pitcher-friendly early. Pitching context: Michael Soroka has the better recent run-prevention profile in the available outing logs at 1.8 ER over the last 5 outings. Batter research is strongest for James Wood, Curtis Mead, Luis García Jr., based on recent hit rates, matching location/opponent samples, or similar-game production. The cold/risk list flags Andrés Chaparro, Pavin Smith because the recent hit profile or strikeout trend is weaker than the projection alone would show.
